votes.motion: to approve the minutes from October 1, 2024

based on the information and findings set forth in the staff report and upon the evidence and explanations received today, to approve the Preliminary Site Plan for Holiday Oil (Fallwater Dr) located at 7825 South Fallwater Drive in the SC-2 zone with the Requirements of Approval listed in the staff report

based on the information and findings set forth in the staff report and upon the evidence and explanations received today, to approve the Preliminary Major Subdivision for Holiday Oil (Fallwater Dr), titled specifically as the Coldstream Commons Subdivision, located at 7825 South Fallwater Drive in the SC-2 zone with the Requirements of Approval listed in the staff report

based on the information and findings set forth in the staff report and upon the evidence and explanations received today, to approve the Administrative Conditional Use Permit for a restaurant, fast food limited for Holiday Oil (Fallwater Dr) located at 7825 South Fallwater Drive in the SC-2 zone with no Conditions of Approval as explained in the staff report

to make a recommendation of approval (positive recommendation) to the City Council for the proposed Copper Meadows General Plan Amendment amending the Future Land Use Map (FLUM) from Future Park, Public Facilities, and Very Low-Density Residential to Low-Density Residential and Parks and Open Land subject to the requirements of approval

to make a recommendation of approval (positive recommendation) to the City Council for the Copper Meadows Master Development Agreement/Plan subject to the requirements of approval as shown in the staff report

to recommend approval (positive recommendation) of the Copper Meadows Rezone of 76.21 acres from Very Low-Density Single Family Residential (VLSFR), Public Facilities (P-F), and Low-Density Single Family (LSFR) to Planned Community (P-C) subject to the requirements of approval in the staff report
